Kathai College of Statics lineage compresses Prestidigitation clockwork rules (another creature may activate; ignite-extinguish single-effect choice example) — core AC/HP/3-device/8-hour mechanics present.

No Phase-2-specific regression tests (per-species trait smoke or sizeChoice wiring); catalog-integrity covers duplicate keys and lineage count only.
